mongolia-2023.heroSubtitle: The steppe awaits — our first chapter
mongolia-2023.statementText: Dust in our wake, purpose in our hearts.
mongolia-2023.splitText: Rally for Rangers donated motorcycles to the Southern Mongolian National Parks, riding roughly 1,800 km across the steppe to reach the rangers who protect it.
mongolia-2023.quoteText: We came to give. We stayed to belong.
mongolia-2023.closingTitle: The road never ends, it only continues

mongolia-2024.heroSubtitle: We came back — year two begins
mongolia-2024.statementText: The mission grew. The bond deepened.
mongolia-2024.splitText:
A Decade of Impact! In honor of this momentous occasion, Rally for Rangers returned to Lake Hovsgol National Park to donate 15 motorcycles — the very place where the spirit of Rally for Rangers was born.

Lake Hovsgol, also known as the "Mother Sea," holds 70% of Mongolia's freshwater and 1% of the Earth's total freshwater reserve. Established in 1992, this pristine park spans a colossal 1.2 million hectares — surpassing the grandeur of Yellowstone National Park in the US.
mongolia-2024.quoteText: Year one you find the road. Year two you become it.
mongolia-2024.closingTitle: Two years, one mission, endless road
